bundle.shortDescription: A light screen recorder for Windows, with a simple editor
bundle.longDescription: OpenStage Recorder records a screen, one window or part of a screen, with your voice, the computer's sound and a webcam if you choose. A simple editor cuts the recording, adds transitions, blur, cover and zoom, balances the sounds, and makes an MP4. It is free and open source under the Apache License 2.0.
